Coram : G.S. SINGHVI, A.K. GANGULY
MOTOR VEHICLES ACT, 1988: c s. 166 - Fatal motor accident - Claim petition - Appreciation of evidence - Claim disallowed by Tribunal as a/so by High Court on the ground that in the FIR the nu ...... ber of offending vehicle and the name of the driver were not mentioned - HELD: In motor accident the case like in a criminal trial - Courts must keep this distinction in mind - In the instant case, the incident was witnessed by the brother of the deceased and a co-villager- The brother of victim rushed him to hospital while the co-villager chased the offending vehicle and caught the driver
Decision Date : 02-03-2011 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2269/2011 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
